column4: 物品说明
木头制成的长剑，多为道士用来驱鬼。（男用）
column10: A longsword made of wood, often used by Taoists to exorcise ghosts. (Male use)

column4: 青铜熔铸而成的长剑，大巧若拙。（男用）
column10: A longsword cast from bronze, great skill appearing clumsy. (Male use)

column4: 生铁打造的长剑，江湖上随处可见。（男用）
column10: A longsword forged from pig iron, commonly seen in the martial world. (Male use)

column4: 厚厚的一块顽铁，虽然笨重，但砍劈时力量巨大。（男用）
column10: A thick, stubborn piece of iron; cumbersome, but delivers great slashing power. (For men)

column4: 剑锋犀利，有青光流溢，冰冷而又带几分雅致。（男用）
column10: The blade is sharp, with a flowing cyan glow, cold yet elegant. (For men)

column4: 精铁打造的长剑，在月光下可以看到剑刃发出神秘的寒光。（男用）
column10: Long sword forged from refined iron. Under moonlight, blade emits mysterious cold light. (For males)

column4: 铸造时吸收日月之光华，因而威力不俗。（男用）
column10: Forged to absorb the brilliance of sun and moon, thus quite powerful. (For men)

column4: 手持此剑者临风挥砍，则听到风声锐利，犹如剑刃直刺人心。（男用）
column10: When wielded and swung in the wind, it produces sharp whistling sounds, as if the blade pierces the heart. (Male)

column4: 挥剑时伴随龙吟清啸，天地之气为之一荡。（男用）
column10: Sword swings accompanied by dragon's roar, stirring the energy of heaven and earth. (For men)

column4: 以千年玄铁打造而成，自行凝聚力量，但要靠内力深厚者激发方可发挥。（男用）
column10: Forged from millennium-old black iron, it accumulates power naturally but requires a master of deep inner strength to unleash it. (Male)

column4: 剑刃刚劲锋利，削铁如泥，即使是玉石这样坚硬的东西，都能在一挥之间碎裂。（男用）
column10: The blade is strong, sharp, and cuts iron like mud. Even something as hard as jade can shatter with a single swing. (For males)

column4: 剑锋犀利，使用时真气在剑尖凝聚成霜，因此得名。（男用）
column10: The sword edge is sharp; when Use, true qi condenses into frost at the tip, hence its name. (For men)

column4: 以寒铁铸造而成的宝剑，柔韧异常，可绕于指上，使用时加以力道，便可爆发无穷力量，实乃以柔克刚之道。（男用）
column10: A sword forged from cold iron, exceptionally flexible, can wrap around a finger. When Use, applying force unleashes immense power, truly soft overcoming hard. (Male use)

column4: 据说铸炼此剑只在夜间进行，剑身吸收星月之气，寒光逼人。（男用）
column10: Forged only at night, the blade absorbs stellar and lunar energy, emitting a chilling gleam. (Male)

column4: 将金刚石料熔于剑身，再用百毒加以炼制，并用马血淬取，伤人即死。（男用）
column10: Forged by melting diamond ore into the blade, tempered with a hundred poisons and horse blood—a single strike can be fatal. (Male)

column4: 能够吸取恶鬼魂魄，提升自身威力的宝剑。（男用）
column10: A sword capable of absorbing evil ghost souls to enhance its own power. (For men)

column4: 此剑挥动之时伴有雷鸣，据说指石石崩，因此得名。（男用）
column10: When this sword is swung, thunder accompanies; said to point at stone and it crumbles, hence its name. (For men)

column4: 此剑一出，便有震慑四野之威，传说将其供奉在祠堂中，便可保一方平安。（男用）
column10: When drawn, this sword radiates awe-inspiring power across the land. Legend says enshrining it in Ancestral Hall ensures peace for the region. (Male use)

column4: 剑身以飞瀑之力养成，剑锋所到之处无坚不摧，劈水则分开水路，劈山则土石崩坏。（男用）
column10: The blade is forged with the power of a flying waterfall; where its edge reaches, nothing stands unbroken—it parts water and shatters mountains. (For males)

column4: 剑刃所至之处裂而无痕、伤不见血，实乃锋锐无比。（男用）
column10: Where the sword blade strikes, it cracks without trace, wounds without blood, truly extremely sharp. (For men)

column4: 此剑通灵，但需要内力深厚的人将其驯化，最终便可达到人剑合一之境。（男用）
column10: This sword Channeling, but requires a master of profound inner strength to tame it, ultimately achieving unity of man and blade. (Male)

column4: 剑出鞘时伴有紫色电光，挥星斩月，所向无敌。（天河）
column10: A sword that emits purple lightning when drawn, capable of cleaving stars and moon, invincible. (Tianhe)

column4: 因可在暗夜之中吸引天地之间火灵，故剑身时常散发出火石之光，灵力异常强大。（紫英）
column10: Because it can attract fire spirits from heaven and earth in the dark night, the sword body often emits a flint-like light, its spiritual power exceptionally strong. (Ziying)

column4: 练实为虚的至高境界，剑出鞘时，如长虹贯日，其景象端丽不可方物。（男用）
column10: The highest realm of turning solid into void. When drawn, the sword gleams like a rainbow piercing the sun, a sight of peerless beauty. (Male)

column4: 剑身若有若无，出剑能引风聚雷，贯注雷霆之威。持有者若未修行仙术，将遭反噬而亡。（男用）
column10: The blade seems intangible; drawing it summons wind and gathers thunder, channeling lightning's might. If the wielder lacks cultivation, they will suffer backlash and die. (For males)

column4: 一种奇门兵器，原本专门用于水战，又称分水峨嵋刺。（菱纱）
column10: An exotic weapon, originally specialized for naval combat, also called water-splitting Emei Daggers. (Lingsha)

column4: 精铁剑身镶以白银，挥动时有银光发出。（菱纱）
column10: Iron sword inlaid with silver, emits silver light when swung. (For Lingsha)

column4: 乌金打造的剑身，短小坚固。（菱纱）
column10: A sword body forged from black gold, short and sturdy. (Lingsha)

column4: 常用的双手武器，轻巧耐用，舞动起来如风如影。（菱纱）
column10: A common two-handed weapon, light and durable, wielded with the grace of wind and shadow. (Lingsha)

column4: 以赤铁打造，轻巧而便于携带，刃部隐隐发出红光。（菱纱）
column10: Forged from red iron, light and easy to carry, the blade faintly emits red light. (Lingsha)

column4: 锋刃犹如新月，薄而锋利，舞动起来攻守兼备。（菱纱）
column10: The blade is like a crescent moon, thin and sharp; wielding it offers both offense and defense. (Lingsha)

column4: 剑柄镶有如意宝玉，据说能通人心，十分珍贵。（菱纱）
column10: The hilt is inlaid with a precious 'Ruyi' jade, said to understand the heart, extremely valuable. (Lingsha)

column4: 蕴含太极之力，能调和五行之气，如以内力催动，则能增加其杀伤力。（菱纱）
column10: Infused with Taiji energy, it harmonizes the five elements. When channeled with inner force, its destructive power increases. (Ling Sha)

column4: 通灵之物，自身带煞，能感应千里之外的杀气。（菱纱）
column10: Channeling object, , can sense killing spirit from a thousand miles away. (Lingsha)

column4: 两端剑刃状如菱角，能吸月华之力，故夜间月光下使用最佳。（菱纱）
column10: The double-edged blade resembles water chestnut, absorbing moonlight; best used at night under the moon. (Lingsha)

column4: 锐利而轻盈，拿在手中更觉有丝丝寒气冒出，绝非凡品。（菱纱）
column10: Sharp and lightweight, holding it feels a slight chill emanating, definitely extraordinary. (For Lingsha)

column4: 剑身流动，如青蛇游走，但由于此武器十分小巧，舞动时只能见其影而不可见其形。（菱纱）
column10: The blade flows like a green serpent, but as this Weapon is extremely small, when wielded, only its shadow is seen, not its form. (For Lingxia)

column4: 剑如其名，利如龙爪，剑身乃是用精钢锻造，无坚不摧。（菱纱）
column10: True to its name, sharp as dragon claws; the blade is forged from fine steel, capable of destroying anything. (Lingsha)

column4: 剑身挥动时有水流飞瀑之声，小巧中见壮阔，十分灵异，因而得名。（菱纱）
column10: When the sword is swung, it makes the sound of flowing water and waterfalls. Small yet majestic, very mystical, hence its name. (Ling Sha)

column4: 此剑广吸山川灵秀之气，凝聚于锋刃之上，故能以剑气伤人于无形。（菱纱）
column10: This sword widely absorbs the spiritual essence of mountains and rivers, concentrating it on its blade, thus able to wound with sword qi intangibly. (Ling Sha)

column4: 剑刃由月光所化，挥动时能逆转五行之气为我所用，故所向披靡。（菱纱）
column10: Blade forged from moonlight; when swung, reverses the five elements' qi for the wielder, making it invincible. (Lingsha)

column4: 异兽之角融合稀世宝石方能铸成此剑，剑成时将异兽灵气尽纳其中，化为温润青芒。（菱纱）
column10: Forged from a mythical beast's horn fused with rare gems, this sword absorbs the beast's spiritual energy upon completion, transforming into a gentle green glow. (For Lingxia)

column4: 通体虹光四溢，锋芒更由乾坤之气所凝，挥动时则天地为之色变，耀目夺魂。（菱纱）
column10: The entire body overflows with rainbow light, its sharp edge condensed from the qi of heaven and earth. When swung, heaven and earth change color, dazzling Soul Snatch. (Lingsha)

column4: 琴柱雕有细小花纹，琴身古色古香。（梦璃）
column10: The qin's pillars are carved with fine patterns, the body has an antique charm. (Mengli)

column4: 此琴弹奏之时会有清香缭绕，让人精神为之一振。（梦璃）
column10: Playing this Qin produces great aroma, refreshing the spirit. (Mengli)

column4: 以上好的古玉雕琢而成琴柱，声音激越，听之能净化心智。（梦璃）
column10: Carved from fine Ancient Jade into qin pegs, sound is vigorous, listening can purify the mind. (For Mengli)

column4: 奏之如空谷之上松风鸣响，嚯嚯有声，共鸣之音能让巨石崩裂。（梦璃）
column10: When played, it sounds like wind through pines over an empty valley, humming with resonance that can shatter giant rocks. (Mengli)

column4: 琴如其名，指尖流出的乐音有如深山幽泉，但需要懂琴之人方可使用。（梦璃）
column10: True to its name, the music flowing from its strings resembles deep mountain Youquan, but only those who understand the qin can Use. (Meng Li)

column4: 此琴用天蚕之丝为弦，内力催动乐声，利可碎玉。（梦璃）
column10: This Qin uses Celestial Silkworm for strings; internal force music, sharp enough to shatter jade. (Mengli)

column4: 弦动之声有如鹤唳，因而得名。稍有内力之人抚琴，便可激发弦乐伤人，此琴便成为利器。（梦璃）
column10: The sound of its strings is like Crane's Cry, hence its name. When played by someone with internal energy, the music can harm others, making this zither a weapon. (Mengli)

column4: 细看便可发现琴身雕有百朵芙蓉，弹奏时犹如奇花绽放，散发异香，能勾人魂魄。（梦璃）
column10: Upon closer inspection, the qin body is carved with a hundred hibiscus flowers; when played, it resembles exotic blooms unfurling, emitting a strange fragrance that can captivate souls. (For Mengli)

column4: 用神鸟尾羽装饰琴柱，抚琴之时会有霞光流溢。（梦璃）
column10: Decorated with divine bird tail feathers on the tuning pegs; playing it causes radiant light to flow. (Mengli)

column4: 此琴半身皆由稀世古玉打造，晶莹剔透，琴弦乃冰丝所化，音起则有阵阵凉气袭人。（梦璃）
column10: Half of this qin is crafted from rare Ancient Jade, crystal clear; its strings are made of ice silk, producing cool gusts with each note. (For Mengli)

column4: 此琴弦利，琴身斑驳遒劲，其实是由金刚之石打磨而成，奏之有如鬼泣。（梦璃）
column10: With sharp strings and a rugged, gnarled body, this qin is actually polished from diamond stone. Playing it sounds like ghostly weeping. (Meng Li)

column4: 此琴又唤“魔琴”，弦丝一动必见血，饮血越多琴身则越发翠绿，故曰碧血。（梦璃）
column10: This zither is also called the 'Demonic Zither.' When its strings move, blood must be seen. The more blood it drinks, the greener the zither body becomes, hence the name 'Jade Blood.' (Mengli)

column4: 琴身镶有无数水晶，璨若晨星。丝弦能吸北斗七星之精气，乐音高亢破天。（梦璃）
column10: The qin body is inlaid with countless crystals, brilliant as morning stars. Its silk strings absorb the essence of the Big Dipper, producing piercing, sky-rending music. (Mengli)

column4: 无弦无丝，却凝结天地之气。乐声悠远绵长，润万物于无声之中。（梦璃）
column10: No strings, yet condenses heaven-earth qi. Music distant and lingering, nourishes all things in silence. (Mengli)

column4: 普通百姓用来束发的头巾。（男用）
column10: Headband used by common folk to tie hair. (Male use)

column4: 用上好的丝绸制成的方巾，颇有儒雅风范。（男用）
column10: A square scarf made of fine silk, quite elegant and refined. (For men)

column4: 做工十分精细的头巾。质地挺括，戴起来感觉神清气爽。（男用）
column10: A very finely crafted Headband. The material is stiff, and wearing it makes one feel refreshed and clear-headed. (For men)

column4: 儒生常戴的帽子，虽然普通，但戴起来风度翩翩。（男用）
column10: A hat commonly worn by scholars; plain, but wearing it gives an air of elegance and grace. (For men)

column4: 金丝线纺织而成，上有龙纹符咒，可使佩戴之人逢凶化吉。（男用）
column10: Woven from golden Silk Thread, with dragon patterns and spells, can bring good fortune to Equip individuals in danger. (For males)

column4: 道家常用的头冠，以元色置于首，有天人合一之意。（男用）
column10: A headband commonly used by Taoists, with black at the head, symbolizing unity of heaven and human. (For men)

column4: 天蚕冰丝编制而成，上嵌避邪宝玉，防护效果极佳，且能清心明目。（男用）
column10: Woven from heavenly silk and ice thread, inlaid with jade to ward off evil. Excellent protective effect, and can clear the mind and brighten the eyes. (Male)

column4: 头巾隐含五灵之力，是一件不可多得的宝物。（男用）
column10: Headband contains hidden Five Elements power, making it a rare treasure. (For men)

column4: 赤金、珠冠，不惧水火，凡修习道法之人，皆梦寐以求。（男用）
column10: Red gold, pearl crown, impervious to water and fire. All who practice Taoism dream of possessing it. (For males)

column4: 因附有仙力，而轻如无物，戴此冠能逼退一切邪气。（天河）
column10: Due to attached immortal power, light as nothing; wearing this crown repels all evil qi. (Tianhe)

column4: 以昆仑紫鸦乌打造，虽然坚固异常，却轻如鸿毛。（紫英）
column10: Forged from Kunlun Purple Crow Black, exceptionally sturdy yet light as a feather. (Ziying)

column4: 传说是天兵神将的头盔，戴上之人便法力大增，神勇异常。（男用）
column10: Legend says it's the Helmet of heavenly soldiers and generals. Wearer gains greatly increased magic power, exceptionally divine bravery. (For males)

column4: 形似日神所佩神冠，蕴含万道瑞气，可赐予人无上神力。（天河）
column10: Resembles the divine crown worn by the sun god, containing myriad auspicious energies, capable of bestowing supreme divine power. (Tianhe)

column4: 极细的紫金丝编织而成，质地轻盈，具有非凡的神力。（紫英）
column10: Woven from extremely fine purple-gold threads, it is lightweight in texture and possesses extraordinary divine power. (Ziying)

column4: 青色的丝织发带，女子束扎头发必备之物。（女用）
column10: A green silk hair ribbon, essential for women to tie up their hair. (For women)

column4: 五色花冠，用来固定头发。色泽艳丽，栩栩如生。（女用）
column10: A five-colored floral crown used to secure hair. Vibrant colors, lifelike. (For women)

column4: 上好丝绸制成的头帕，上有金银丝绣成的花纹。（女用）
column10: A headscarf made of fine silk, embroidered with gold and silver thread patterns. (For women)

column4: 设计巧妙的发带，用七彩丝绳制成，有多种束法。（女用）
column10: A cleverly designed hairband made of colorful silk cords, with various tying methods. (For women)

column4: 冰蚕丝织就而成的锦帕，又被染制成绯红色，束扎头发时如片片荷花花瓣。（女用）
column10: A brocade kerchief woven from ice Silk, dyed crimson. When tying hair, it resembles lotus petals. (Female use)

column4: 半月型的梳子镶以银边，看起来贵重精致，据说还有避邪的作用。（女用）
column10: A crescent-shaped comb edged with silver, appears precious and exquisite; said to ward off evil. (Female)

column4: 琅环玉打磨而成的灵物，七颗玉石排列成北斗七星状，佩戴它有助于吸取体内毒素。（女用）
column10: A spiritual object polished from Langhuan Jade, seven gems arranged like the Big Dipper; Equip aids in drawing toxins from the body. (For females)

column4: 双色天蚕丝系着的铃铛，一金一银，遇到投缘之人，铃铛便会发出五彩霞光。（女用）
column10: A bell tied with a two-colored sky Silk ribbon, one gold, one silver. When meeting a kindred spirit, the bell emits multicolored light. (Female use)

column4: 犹如以霞丝织就，无风自动，煞是好看，甚至被误以为是风神流落人间的宝贝。（女用）
column10: As if woven from rosy cloud silk, it moves without wind, extremely beautiful. It's even mistaken for a treasure lost by the Wind God in the mortal world. (For females)

column4: 取神木“蕉柳”之名，古朴生香，本身使用的玉石亦是极为罕见，通灵通神。（菱纱）
column10: Named after the divine wood 'Jiao Liu,' simple and fragrant. The Use jade itself is extremely rare, with Channeling connecting to the divine. (Lingsha)

column4: 纯金打造，并镶嵌各种避邪之物，显得十分高贵。（梦璃）
column10: Made of pure gold and inlaid with various exorcism items, appearing very noble. (Mengli)

column4: 可避水火二气，每日清晨便幻化出隐隐霞光。（女用）
column10: Repels fire and water qi, emitting faint morning glow at dawn. (For women)

column4: 身具灵气之人，佩之则绽放出青碧霞光，犹如天女降临，威仪万方。（菱纱）
column10: When worn by a person with spiritual energy, it emits a green-blue glow, like a heavenly maiden descending, majestic and awe-inspiring. (Ling Sha)

column4: 神奇的古玉制成，可随心幻化出护体之光。（梦璃）
column10: Made from magical Ancient Jade, it can conjure a protective light at will. (For Mengli)

column4: 交领长袍，市井中最常见的装束。（男用）
column10: Cross-collar Long Robe, most common attire in the market. (For men)

column4: 很受江湖豪客欢迎的外衣，穿上它会让人显得高大挺拔。（男用）
column10: A very popular outer garment among martial artists; wearing it makes one appear tall and straight. (For men)

column4: 绣有流云图案的披风，做工精细，质地轻薄。（男用）
column10: A cloak embroidered with cloud patterns, finely crafted and lightweight. (For men)

column4: 据说被得道之人施过符咒，不仅能够驱寒，还能抵御疾病。　（男用）
column10: Reportedly enchanted by an enlightened one; not only wards off cold but also resists diseases. (Male)

column4: 薄而挺的绵袍，上绣华丽花纹，在贵族子弟中很流行。（男用）
column10: A thin yet stiff silk robe embroidered with luxurious patterns, very popular among noble youths. (For men)

column4: 做工精良，是很好的保暖衣装。　（男用）
column10: Well-made, good warm clothing. (For men)

column4: 珍贵的黑貂皮毛缝制而成，光可鉴人。（男用）
column10: Sewn from precious black sable fur, glossy enough to reflect light. (Male use)

column4: 宫制的锦帛为底，上面镶嵌无数细小鳞甲片，在阳光下十分耀眼。（男用）
column10: Made from palace-woven brocade as base, inlaid with countless tiny scale plates, dazzling in sunlight. (Male)

column4: 附有较强法力的法衣，具有驱魔避邪的功能。（男用）
column10: A ritual robe with strong magical power, capable of exorcising evil. (For men)

column4: 甲胄表面布满不同颜色的细鳞，远看恍如云纹，隐隐流动。（男用）
column10: Armor surface covered with fine scales of different colors, from afar looks like cloud patterns, faintly flowing. (For males)

column4: 金钢抽丝编制而成的铠甲，坚固耐用而不沉重，是上好的防具。（男用）
column10: Armor woven from drawn steel threads, sturdy and durable yet not heavy, an excellent defensive gear. (Male)

column4: 此甲柔韧轻薄，穿上则凡俗兵器皆不能伤其身。（男用）
